slots.notes: Small rounded-full image pill (w-20/sm:w-24, h-10/sm:h-12) set bg-cover, displayed inline inside the H1 next to the word 'World-class'. Wide rounded-pill crop, not square.

Three HLS (.m3u8) card-background videos that fill the dark right-column cards behind z-10 content. All autoPlay, muted, loop, playsInline, preload=auto. Card 1: object-cover full-bleed. Card 2: scaled 150% center-translated. Card 3: scaled 280% center-translated. Delivered as Mux HLS streams (hls.js with native-Safari canPlayType fallback).

mechanic: 100vh sticky two-column hero where a left text column and a right grid of three HLS-video cards both fade-up (translateY+opacity+blur, staggered 150ms) on load, with inline image/play pills embedded in the oversized headline.
techDelivery: single-file React with CDN Tailwind, Poppins from Google Fonts, and hls.js for Mux HLS streaming (useRef per video, single useEffect attaching all 3 streams with native-Safari fallback)
reskinNotes: Colors are declared as Tailwind HSL design tokens (bg/foreground/hero-btn) so retheming is token-level, but the three card backgrounds are HLS video URLs hardcoded inline with per-card object-scale transforms (cover / 150% / 280%) that assume specific source framing; the four-line headline with inline image+play pills is hardcoded in JSX and is highly font-metric- and line-break-dependent (Poppins sizing across 4 breakpoints), and dark card surfaces rely on white/85 and white/80 text plus bg-background circle buttons rather than named tokens.
